    • SaleItem

      public SaleItem(int drinkId, int iceLevelId, int sweetnessId, List<Integer> toppingIds, BigDecimal drinkPrice, List<BigDecimal> toppingPrices)
      Creates a sale item record. Topping ids and prices are paired by index; null or empty lists mean no toppings.
      Parameters:
      drinkId - drink id
      iceLevelId - ice level id
      sweetnessId - sweetness id
      toppingIds - topping ids
      drinkPrice - drink price
      toppingPrices - topping prices
